title: A docs check refuses a duplicate docs id or a leftover -next id
notes: Follow-up from #352: a worker now writes a new docs id as <feature>-<kind>-next and numbers it at the final merge of main. Nothing stops a '-next' or two entries with one id from merging. Add it to pnpm lint's markdown step (and CI): every '(<feature>-<rule|decision>-<n>)' heading id is unique per feature, and none ends in -next.
